meta.claim_scope: current-state warm throughput on one seeded OpenWebText slice; local unreleased tokie wheel vs public gigatoken 0.11.0 and public HF tokenizers 0.23.3; not a regression study
meta.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M

host.label: one pre-validation snapshot; not sampled during timing and not causal proof

tokie.provenance: local build installed from --tokie-wheel; the 0.2.0 version string does not identify this artifact and it is not claimed as published

decode.description: the same precomputed 1-D contiguous np.uint32 ids -> str
decode.input: one shared contiguous uint32 array per document, built outside every clock
decode.counted_inside_clock: len(str) characters; decoded UTF-8 bytes computed outside clock
decode.note: adapters differ by library; not comparable to an earlier bytes-only decode benchmark

adapters.giga: Tokenizer.encode_batch(texts, parallel=n>1) -> awkward Array with leading 0 offset

batch.note: public output types differ; Giga is not flattened inside any clock; one pass per round; batch input is the larger seeded sample

timing.warmth: warm throughput only; cold starts were not retimed and old cold data stays frozen
timing.profile: one unprofiled process CPU vs wall pass per library and task after rounds; no cProfile or perf trace

changes: decode: removed tokens_s_* aliases; chars_s_* retained
batch: removed tokens_s_* and chars_s_*; count_s_* retained; count_unit renamed ids_and_documents
summary_correction.note: Units-only correction derived from unchanged rounds and counts; no seconds, counts, checksums, validation, profiles, or MiB/s values changed.
